correctness.rationale: For every q>=2,r>=q, n=r+1, exactly one run has length two. Li–Wang–Fu Lemma 10 monotonically reduces all run-label choices to cyclic labels for each fixed composition. The exact distinct-subsequence recurrence H_va=(1+z)H_v-z^(m-p+1)H_prefix, or (1+z)H_v for a new symbol, is derived by bijective last-occurrence counting. Modulo z^(q+1), periodic repeats contribute -z^q, the doubled letter contributes -z(1+z)^(r-1), and delayed repeats after insertion contribute (r-j-q+1)_+ instances of -z^q. The coefficient formula and minimum of two positive parts yield all quantifiers/boundaries. The package checker directly enumerates 540 canonical cyclic examples and 40,680 general words with all t<=q, agreeing with theorem. These finite checks are auxiliary.

value.rationale: The January 2026 motivating work explicitly identifies exact extrema when r does not divide length as unresolved. Length n=r+1 is the smallest nondivisible run-rich case: a single extra symbol forms one doubled run. Computing all deletion orders through t=q proves the first order where cyclic symbol repeats make placement matter, with an exact location penalty and a closed optimizer interval for every alphabet/run count. This explains why a generic balanced-upper-bound substitution cannot detect the correct optimum and supplies a reusable short-run benchmark. It is a motivated infinite family rather than an arbitrary isolated numerical invariant; its scope is explicitly limited.
